components.notes: **Cursor pagination, never offset** — offset drifts under concurrent writes, which on a venue's busiest hour is a list that skips rows.

overlays.body: **Collects what `setEventType` sends before it is called.** Required: `code`, `name`. Optional: `hasPerformances`, `capacityBasis`, `ticketNamesDate`, `multiDay`, `requiresRegistration`, `requiresAccreditation`, `seatingModesAllowed`, `defaultLifecycle`. `id` is a client UUIDv7 generated silently, never asked. Dismissing sends nothing; the screen behind is unchanged.

name: Event Duplication & Clone Configuration

transitions.trigger: Back to Event Catalogue Command Center

patternReason: One event copied with the parts and date shift chosen (defined 4 October 2026 from cloneEvent, CHG-FXS-001).
purpose: Copy an existing event, with the parts and dates chosen, to start a new one.
purposeNote: Eligible event transactions can trigger automated invoice requests with complete event and customer references while financial posting remains controlled by Finance. Purpose rewritten 2 October 2026 (CHG-WIR-026): The purpose was pack text attached by page rather than by screen and does not describe this screen; it is rewritten from the screen's name and operations (design-notes correction ticketing-backoffice BO-696)

components.label: New event name
components.notes: Body newName; the source name with ' (copy)' by default.

components.label: New event code
components.notes: **Event codes are unique per tenant** (audit R108), so the copy needs its own. Prefilled with the source's code and the first free suffix (`-2`, `-3`, ...); a code already in use is refused `409 duplicate-code` and the form says so beside the field, keeping everything else (CHG-R4-016).

components.label: Copy
components.notes: Body include[]: the parts to copy (performances, prices, capacities, resources, content); all ticked by default.

components.label: Move dates by (days)
components.notes: Body shiftDatesByDays; 0 keeps the dates, 7 moves every performance a week on.

components.label: Copy event
components.notes: On 201 opens the new event (the eventId and code returned) as a draft.

states.error: Could not load the event. Names it; nothing is copied.
states.emptyFirstRun: Not used: the screen opens on one event (eventId).
states.emptyNoResults: The filter narrowed it and the event duplication clone are still there. Names the active filter and offers to clear it.
states.emptyNoAccess: Shown when the caller lacks `PRODUCT_VIEW`, which `getEvent` requires to show this screen, and names that permission. **Never an empty table** — that reads as *there is no data* and sends somebody to support with the wrong question. A caller who can see the screen but lacks what an action needs sees that action disabled, naming its permission: `EVENT_CONFIGURE` for `cloneEvent`.
